info.name: HandCO API
info.description:
Full /api/v1 collection for H&CO ecommerce. All client-facing ids are **rids**. Spec fields productId/addressId are rid strings.

Import HandCO.local environment and set baseUrl. Run folder scripts or Flows under postman/flows/.

item.name: Cart
item.description: Send X-Cart-Id with cartRid. Add item captures cartRid from response header.
